description: Write record batches of two rows and claim them 1 KB of body at a time, so scans read thousands of footer blocks in thousands of parallel claims.
on_new_connection: LOAD nanoarrow; SET GLOBAL arrow_debug_batch_rows = 2; SET GLOBAL arrow_debug_claim_bytes = 1024;

skip_tests.reason: Sizes, bytes read, request counts and compression gains are asserted for batches of normal size.
The extension is loaded before the test checks it is not.
